# Observed Delta and Exact Touch Plan

## New evidence since the three planning passes

- `/apps` renders from `apps/scripts/catalog/index.mjs`, which composes `creation.mjs`; therefore only `creation.mjs` needs existing-catalog modification.
- `geelooy/api/*/_awtsmoos.derech.js` folders are automatically mounted by the existing dynamic server. The server composition root does not need modification.
- Dynamic routes register with `$i.use({...})`; raw JSON bodies may arrive under `$i.$_POST.__raw_body__`.
- Node runtime is v24.17.0 and server default is port 8080.
- `MINIMAX_API_KEY` is currently missing from the observed runtime, creating an external credential boundary for a paid live H3 success test.
- Official H3 docs permit JSON multimodal URL/data input under a 64 MB total body and explicitly advise public URLs for large files and avoiding Base64; the client will use Base64 only for bounded local assets and will also support direct public URL references.
- Official current H3 pricing is $0.08/output-second at 768P, $0.13/output-second at 2K, audio input free, first five images free then $0.04/image, and reference video input billed per input second at the selected output-resolution rate.

## Exact existing file rewritten in full

- `geelooy/apps/scripts/catalog/creation.mjs` — preserve every current entry and add Olam H3 Studio.

## Exact new server files

- `geelooy/api/olam-h3/_awtsmoos.derech.js` — route facade only.
- `geelooy/api/olam-h3/core/body.js` — JSON body extraction.
- `geelooy/api/olam-h3/core/validation.js` — server trust boundary for H3 structured requests.
- `geelooy/api/olam-h3/core/mapper.js` — internal generation → exact MiniMax V2 payload.
- `geelooy/api/olam-h3/core/client.js` — bearer-auth fetch to MiniMax create/query endpoints.
- `geelooy/api/olam-h3/core/handlers.js` — status/create/task route orchestration and meaningful normalized errors.

## Deliberate exclusions

- No second backend application.
- No H3-Max UI until its pricing and model-specific experience are intentionally added; the provider/model registry is ready for it later.
- No full API key display or browser storage.
- No claim of authoritative MiniMax billing; all cost analytics are explicitly app-recorded estimates unless MiniMax returns an authoritative money field in the future.
- No automatic large-file upload host is invented. Local blobs use bounded Base64; large assets can be stored locally for reuse but must have/use a public source URL for generation when the encoded request would cross the safe body ceiling.

## Implementation order

1. Write all new server and client production code, plus the full catalog rewrite.
2. Read every touched production file and inspect line/format boundaries.
3. Write tests.
4. Run syntax, isolated contract, server runtime, browser, persistence, responsive, and `/apps` regression checks.
5. Write a first-pass planned-vs-actual delta and resolve all actionable findings.
